parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. The DataAgent must exist in the current account. The name can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must be 4 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，须为当前账号下已存在的 DataAgent。仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与中划线（-），长度 4~128 个字符
parameters.name: name

schema.description_en: The response body that contains the complete configuration of the DataAgent
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回该 DataAgent 的完整配置

contextModels.description_en: The list of context model names associated with the DataAgent
contextModels.description_zh: 该 DataAgent 关联的上下文模型名称列表

items.description_en: The name of a context model
items.description_zh: 单个上下文模型的名称

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format in the UTC time zone, accurate to seconds
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC 时区的 ISO8601 格式，精确到秒

description.description_en: The description of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if no description is set
description.description_zh: DataAgent 的描述。未设置时返回空串
description.example: 负责分析订单与收入相关日志，并按日输出汇总报表

displayName.description_en: The display name. Returns an empty string if not set, which is not backfilled with the name field. Use displayName || name as a fallback for display purposes
displayName.description_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退
displayName.title_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退。

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the DataAgent
roleArn.description_zh: DataAgent 扮演的 RAM 角色 ARN

systemPrompt.description_en: The system prompt of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if no system prompt is set
systemPrompt.description_zh: DataAgent 的系统提示词。未设置时返回空串
systemPrompt.example: 你是订单域的数据分析助手，只回答与订单、收入相关的问题，不确定时说明原因而不是猜测

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last update. The format is the same as that of createdAt
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次更新的时间，格式同 createdAt

userId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the DataAgent belongs
userId.description_zh: 该 DataAgent 归属的阿里云账号 ID
